integrity: The argument is a direct semantic consequence of the printed Definition 5.1: preservation of all formulas in a classical language is symmetric because negations are also formulas. This makes every associated frame an equivalence frame. A separate three-world reflexive nontransitive model witnesses failure of axiom 4 for an allowed minimal FOT-based modal extension of a base theory extending Robinson arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The finding targets the Section 5 Kripke accessibility definition and completeness theorem as stated. It does not assess the independent Boolean-valued completeness theorem of Section 4, and it does not supply a full repaired Kripke semantics.
title: Truth-preservation accessibility collapses the forcing Kripke frames to S5
